This shader is valid HLSL and should compile. Watch the compile time and the
exit status rather than the output: on a Release build (which is what Compiler
Explorer runs) the SROA_HLSL pass spins instead of finishing, so the pane
should stall and end in a timeout or a killed process rather than producing
DXIL or an error message. An assert-enabled build stops instead, in
SROA_Helper::RewriteBitCast.

Two one-line edits in the source below both make it compile: giving BaseStruct
a non-empty member, or removing the assignment of the empty struct.
